correctness.rationale: PASS: For each index-graph edge (i,j), the relative permutation Q_ij=pi_i^{-1}pi_j classifies the isomorphism type of the pair of directed successor paths, so all pair-local FO² truth tests depend only on Q_ij. For a forest, root labels together with independent edge differences form a bijective coordinate system of k independently uniform permutations. On a cycle, equality-of-successor sentences have joint probability (n!)^{-(k-c(G))} versus product (n!)^{-|E(G)|}, proving the iff. For quantitative overlaps, an ordered edge is present with probability 1/n; two distinct compatible edges with probability 1/[n(n-1)]. The exact triple sum over directed edges yields raw moment (n^4-4n^3+8n^2-8n+1)/[n²(n-1)²] and centered third cumulant (n^4-2n^3+2n²-4n+1)/[n³(n-1)²], positive even for n=2. Independent full enumeration of 2!,3!,4! order triples reproduced cumulants 1/8,17/54,145/576 exactly. These finite tests support the all-n enumeration and forest-coordinate proof.
